title: Irreducible proper 2-knots from exotic open 2-handles
summary: We construct infinite families of irreducible exotic proper knotted surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$, making progress on a question of Gompf. Here irreducible means these surfaces are not end-sums of standard surfaces with exotic planes. To prove the topological equivalence, we give a highly flexible construction of exotic open 2-handles, which generalizes several similar constructions in the literature.
